rule: A case already in gated_v2 keeps its routing verdict and grade. A case new to gated_v3 needs a routing verdict from a census card before it scores, and only MATCH scores.

taxonomy.MATCH: The headline reports an event of the routed template family at the resolved issuer, and at least one attached filing reports that event.
taxonomy.NO_EVENT: The headline reports no issuer event of the template family (market report, commentary, list, quote page, solicitation).
taxonomy.OTHER_EVENT: The headline event is real and the resolved issuer is its subject, but no attached filing reports it.
taxonomy.WRONG_ISSUER: The resolved issuer is not the subject of the headline.
